title: A Collective has a network home: one shared calendar and a directory of its member Spaces
detail:
PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), built on the collaborator calendar. Required before Founding Collective sells. Public network home now composes eligible same-owner active network member Spaces and the existing published-event tenancy/hosting/accepted-share reader. Every month re-resolves caller-visible parent and child eligibility; owner management remains a separate billing door. Cancellations stay calendar context and never lead Up next. 47 focused visibility/cross-tenant, calendar and server-render checks pass, along with full typecheck. Public directory and each month load recheck source access; the plain-Node consequence probe remains runner-free. Deployment follows LIVE-763.

Completeness repair: bounded exclusive-next-day month reads page every owned/hosted branch with timestamp+ID ordering, paginate accepted-share IDs and the public directory, batch home eligibility and read four source Spaces at a time. Actual shipped-query runner-free fixtures exceed1200 members/events/shares/home IDs, retain last-day late timestamps, exclude600 following-month events and surface later-page failure through the existing calendar retry alert.59 targeted reader/action/server-page tests and final8GB typecheck pass on d7b355cd3 current main, excluding already-merged763 ancestry. No production writes.
